evals.prompt: Just inherited this repo — sweep every installed dep for typosquat or malware family hits before I touch anything.
evals.expected_output: Lockfile-driven `--installed` mode, parallel `vulnetix scan --block-malware` + `vdb ai-malware list` calls, ALLOW/WARN/BLOCK table per direct dep, and a memory append plus history-review note for any BLOCK.
expectations: Reads .vulnetix/capabilities.yaml and uses derived.primary_package_manager to select the correct lockfile to enumerate direct deps from
Runs `vulnetix scan --block-malware -o json` and `vulnetix vdb ai-malware list -o json` to fetch AI-malware family intel
Renders a table with columns Package, Version, Verdict (ALLOW/WARN/BLOCK), Reason citing similarity score, stars, age, or AI-malware family match
For any BLOCK verdict suggests `git log -p -- <package-manifest-path>` before removal and notes that removing is destructive
Appends a single consolidated `event: typosquat-check` entry to .vulnetix/memory.yaml with the verdicts

evals.prompt: Someone PR'd a dep called `react-utill` — is that a typosquat of react-util or legitimate?
evals.expected_output: Single-package mode: `vulnetix vdb packages search react-utill --ecosystem npm` for similarity scores plus an ai-malware lookup, rendered as a one-row ALLOW/WARN/BLOCK verdict with similarity reasoning.
expectations: Treats $ARGUMENTS=react-utill as single-package mode (does not enumerate lockfile)
Runs `vulnetix vdb packages search react-utill --ecosystem npm -o json` for similarity hits
Also runs `vulnetix scan --block-malware -o json` and `vulnetix vdb ai-malware list -o json` (filtered by package/ecosystem) in parallel
Renders a one-row verdict table citing the Levenshtein similarity score against react-util plus maintainer-health signals (stars, age) in the Reason column
Appends an `event: typosquat-check` entry with the verdict to memory.yaml and notes false-positive risk for legitimate near-name packages

evals.prompt: A new AI-malware family was disclosed — cross-reference our installed Python deps against it and flag anything we should pull.
evals.expected_output: `--installed` mode against requirements/poetry lockfile, parallel scan + ai-malware lookup with --ecosystem pypi, ALLOW/WARN/BLOCK table, urgent flagging on BLOCKs, memory append.
expectations: Reads .vulnetix/capabilities.yaml and confirms primary_package_manager is pypi/poetry before iterating the lockfile
Runs `vulnetix scan --block-malware -o json` and `vulnetix vdb ai-malware list -o json --ecosystem pypi` in parallel
For each installed direct dep cross-references the AI-malware family list and the typosquat-similarity scores from `vdb packages search`
Renders the Package / Version / Verdict / Reason table and treats any BLOCK as urgent with a strong removal recommendation plus `git log -p -- <manifest>` history review
Writes a single consolidated `event: typosquat-check` entry to .vulnetix/memory.yaml capturing each verdict
